name: Far East Horizon Limited
summary: Far East Horizon Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Financial and advisory; and Industrial Operation segments. The company offers direct finance leasing; sale-leaseback; factoring; entrusted loans; operating lease and sale of related equipment and materials; engineering technical services; advisory and construction services.
